name: Terraria (tModLoader)
description: Modded Terraria via tModLoader. Official release zip downloaded from GitHub (always the latest stable).

variables.label: World name
variables.description: World file name under worlds/ (created on first start).

notes: The launch script downloads a private .NET runtime on first start (needs curl or wget on the host). Mods: place .tmod files in ~/.local/share/Terraria/tModLoader/Mods (or use the console's 'modpacks'/workshop tooling) and enable them in enabled.json. The console accepts Terraria commands (help, save, exit) — 'exit' saves the world before shutting down. Clients must run the same tModLoader version.
